areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Emergency-support objective, product and response-time indicator exist, but only a very small share of resources; little relevance and no area-specific innovation.

areas.name: Family farming
areas.reason: Low-carbon agribusiness objective, product and value-added indicator, but very small resource share; financial innovation not specific to the area.

areas.name: Decarbonization
areas.reason: Directly related objective and several products and indicators, but resource share is not relevant and the fund-level innovation is not specific to industrialization.

areas.name: Competitiveness
areas.reason: Core of the programme: productivity, investment attraction and diversification; direct objectives and indicators; over half of resources; exceptional, replicable innovative fund design.

areas.name: Science, technology and innovation
areas.reason: Innovation-ecosystem objective, products and incubation indicator, but small resource share; impact limited to one front of the fund; financial innovation generic.

areas.name: Labor
areas.reason: Job creation is an indirect effect of the fund's success, so products were counted under competitiveness and no resources specifically attributed; limited impact.

areas.name: Logistics and transport
areas.reason: Logistics-infrastructure product and road service-level indicator, but a small resource share and no efficiency or innovation features identified.

areas.name: Fiscal sustainability
areas.reason: Liquidity-buffer product and specific objective relate to fiscal sustainability, but small resources and an indicator that only maintains an already top level; low impact.

areas.name: Trade
areas.reason: Export diversification appears in the general objective and an indicator, but no specific objective is directly tied to international trade.

not_accepted.name: Trade
not_accepted.reason: Export diversification appears in the general objective and an indicator, but no specific objective is directly tied to international trade.

bonus.reason: Proponent did not state the programme is exclusively aimed at federal PPA priorities.
Proponent did not state the programme promotes regional integration.
